name: gitops-sentinel-poc
description: Every 30 minutes, check the hello-caipe ArgoCD app for drift/degraded health and file a GitHub issue if something's wrong.
prompt: Run the gitops-sentinel skill against the ArgoCD application 'hello-caipe' (namespace poc-demo). Search open GitHub issues labeled 'gitops-sentinel' before creating a new one. Only report/act if something is unhealthy or out of sync.
